technicalReviewer: Fable review seat (agent source check against a28331f7); the feature owner's human technical review is not recorded here
author: Codex documentation author
frontend: The conversations lab at port 43302 (Mailpit 48427) for all three guides; separate browser sessions for Priya Raman (the other Legal Team Member) and Ravi Menon (Contributor); the lab API under each acting identity for prerequisite records and read-back, and under the Administrator for the Status rename, the template archive/restore and description edit, and the Confidential relation target
browser: Playwright 1.62.1 driving the installed Chromium 1243 build from the shared Playwright cache, headless, one isolated context per identity at 1280×1800 CSS px; scripts written by the reviewer from the guide text
fixturePreparation: Reused by identifier the author's Matter types (plain, required, single, multi, retype), their attached Fields, the single/alpha/beta templates, the open and closed Statuses, the live Entity, the Matter-linked Contract type, and the seeded accounts. Every walked record was created fresh by the reviewer with a 'Rev …' title and the run stamp; the author's Matters were only opened read-only for control probes.

C22: per role, direct creation in the dialog (required text, Entity and person references, Manager Priya Raman, Confidential), a second Confidential Matter for the outsider/team-role checks, a template creation of the single type, and a stale-template attempt with the beta template archived by the Administrator's API while the form was open and restored afterwards. The single template's description was edited and reverted by API to show that later template edits do not touch the copied rows.

C23: per role, a Matter with one plain child and one Confidential child created by the Administrator, a linked Contract, one Task and one Key date five days out, all by the acting role's API session. The Administrator's API renamed the 'Docs Matter otherOpen' Status to 'Resolved <stamp>' for the relabel check and renamed it back. Closing the Matter before the archive check and adding Ravi Menon as Contributor used the API.

C24: per role, a Confidential Matter with the acting role as Manager and Ravi Menon as Contributor, a parent, a related Matter managed by Priya Raman, a Confidential Matter of the Administrator's for the Restricted Matter check, a second Matter for moving the Contract link, and a standalone Contract with an inline Counterparty, all by API. Closing and reopening for the Key date state check, archiving and restoring for the freeze check, and the Administrator's Confidential relation used the API; every other action used the page controls.
corrections: No guide text changed as a result of the walkthrough: every checked instruction and outcome in the three guides matched the app on the tested bytes, which are the bytes in the evidence records.
observations: Issue #770 reproduced in both roles: an optional Field cleared in the Create dialog while a template was selected came back as the template default on the saved Matter; clearing it on Overview persisted and a nonempty replacement saved normally, as the guide says.

The Create dialog refuses with an alert naming the missing Fields ("Fill Docs Matter required …, Docs Matter entity …."); clearing a required Field on Overview marks it invalid with "Fill … first — the type requires it."; a stale template answers "The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type."; a blank Task answers "Name what needs doing."

Change matter type opens "Change matter type to <type>" with the new type's required Fields; a number Field is a spinbutton. Cancel keeps the old type; after switching back, the value entered for the other type stays in the record but is not shown.

The Close dialog reads "Closing is a signal, not a lock. The Matter leaves active surfaces but stays fully writable." and lists open children under "These child Matters will stay open."; the Legal Team Member saw the Confidential child as "Restricted Matter" while the Administrator saw its title. Reopen reads "Its original opened date is preserved."; Archive reads "The matter leaves the default list. Its history and M-number are kept."

Restoring a closed archived Matter leaves it closed with no Next date; the Matters list needed both Show archived and Show closed to list it. Once a filter is active the Filter button reads "Filter 1" and each filter has a removable chip.

Remove Task removes the row immediately; Remove date asks "Remove Key date? …" first. The Task due date never appeared on Key dates or as the list's Next deadline; the Key date dialog offers Date, Event and Note only.
Choosing a child as its own parent's parent is refused in the dialog with "That parent would close a loop in the Matter hierarchy."

Linking a plain Contract to a Confidential Matter opened "Confidentiality differs" ("C-… and M-… keep independent Confidential flags. Consider aligning them if that matches the work."); Leave them as they are linked without changing either flag. Linking the same Contract elsewhere by API answered 409 until Unlink; linking to a plain Matter showed no dialog.

A Contributor on the Matter team saw a parent he is not on as "Restricted Matter" even though that parent is not Confidential, saw a linked Contract he is not on as "Restricted contract", had no add/edit controls and a disabled completion box, and his direct Task, Key date, relation, Status, archive and restore writes answered 403.

Navigating directly to a Confidential Matter the reader cannot open rendered "Something went wrong. The page could not load." while the API answered 404; the relationship row itself showed only "Restricted Matter".

Earlier reviewer runs failed on harness assumptions, not on app or guide behaviour: the retype Field is a spinbutton rather than a textbox; the Key dates tab reached by the in-app tab link still showed the pre-reopen rows until the page was reloaded; the Filter button is renamed once a filter is active; a completed Task's checkbox is named "Reopen Task"; and the reviewer expected the Contributor to see the parent's title. Each was corrected in the harness and the run repeated on unchanged bytes; these records hold only the completed runs.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Browser contexts were 1280×1800 CSS px; the discovery record's layout checks are CSS-pixel measurements, not browser zoom or assistive technology acceptance.

Prerequisite records, the Status relabel, the template archive/restore and description edit, the Contributor team role, and (in the C24 run) closing, reopening, archiving and restoring were applied through the lab API; the C23 run exercised the Close, Reopen, Archive and Restore dialogs themselves.
Not exercised: uploading a Document to a closed Matter (the author record covers it), linking an archived Contract or Matter, Request conversion, and Comments/notifications from these guides' links.

Linked guides remain unpublished: types and Statuses and Fields, Matter templates (administrator configuration), and Document Versions and Document reading (DOC-017). The three articles stay in review.
Disposable reviewer records remain in the owned lab, including two 'Rev lifecycle' Matters left archived by the first, aborted lifecycle run.
